items.label: text
items.text: Unlike diamond and graphite C6o fullerene does dissolve in some solvents; only relatively weak intermolecular forces of attraction have to be broken for it to dissolve.

items.label: list_item
items.text: C60fullerene is not as hard as diamond. It does not take as much energy to break the intermolecular forces of attraction in C6o fullerene compared to breaking the strong covalent bonds in diamond.

items.label: text
items.text: C6ofullerene does not conduct electricity. Although all the carbon atoms in C60only form three bonds, the fourth electron on each atom can only move around within each C6o molecule; the electrons cannot jump from molecule to molecule.
